name: Pleasanton Police Teen Academy and Explorer Program
what_you_do: Start with the free one-week Teen Academy, taught by Pleasanton officers. Teens who finish can apply to be Explorers, who train in ride-alongs, crime scenes and traffic control, compete, and help at city events.
who_can_apply: Teen Academy: local high school students ages 14 to 18. Explorers: ages 14 to 20 when you apply, at least a C average, and you must go to a Pleasanton school or college, live in Pleasanton, or have a family member who works for the city. You must finish the Teen Academy first.
duration: Teen Academy: one week. Explorers: ongoing, with meetings twice a month.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 Teen Academy are closed. 2027 dates are not posted. No Explorer deadline is stated.
how_to_apply: For the Teen Academy, contact the Community Services Unit at (925) 931-5100. For Explorers, fill out the Explorer application (a printable version is linked) and pass an oral interview and background check.
notes: Explorers need good moral character and no history of negative police contacts or poor conduct (the page lists running away and poor school attendance). The page links an Explorer brochure and application PDF that we could not read, so its details are not used. The city's Behind the Badge and V.I.P.S. programs are 18+ only. The Police Cadet job on the city job board is for college students 18+.
